tensions: The real tension this run is not which coin to buy, it is that the scan sheet and the account disagreed. Two positions were closed manually and the pipeline would have reported on phantom holdings had it trusted its own table. It did not — but the table still needs fixing. Second tension: adding $190 to NEAR pushes one name to roughly a third of the portfolio. The ride-the-wave doctrine says press winners and never trim; basic position sizing says do not let one alt become a third of a $1,450 book. Both cannot be fully right. We sided with the doctrine because it is the stated mandate, but the concentration is a real exposure, not a rounding error, and if NEAR's breakout fails the drawdown will be felt across the whole account. Third, quieter tension: Robinhood returned an empty quote for INJ and we priced it off OKX. One missing quote is noise; a pattern of them would mean the data layer cannot be trusted for the position it is valuing.

opening.text: The book changed shape overnight without us. SOL and XTZ were sold manually at 22:05 ET on the 16th — SOL out at $99.24 for +6.1% on an $89 basis, XTZ out at $0.2493 for -14.6%. Net $180 back into cash, which is why buying power reads $193.52 and not the $13 the scan sheet expected. Seven positions now, not nine. The position table is stale and should be rewritten before the next run.

Regime is chop, not trend. BTC $76,182, flat on the day, -2.1% on the week, but still +19% on the month. Dominance 58.8%, Fear & Greed 50 — dead neutral. Total market cap -2.9% in 24 hours. This is a market digesting a month-long move, not starting or ending one. Four of seven holdings are red, all of them positions opened within the last two weeks. None of that is a signal; it is entry timing colliding with a flat tape.

Portfolio $1,450.55 against $1,231 deposited — up 17.8%. ZEC carries the book at +28.8% and +166% on the month. NEAR is +16.8% and printed +15.8% today, a genuine one-day breakout while everything else sat still. The laggards: XRP -11.4%, INJ -10.2%, XLM -7.5%, ADA -7.3%. ADA is the one worth naming — deepest drawdown from all-time high in the book at -94%, and the weakest 30-day performer at +14.4%. Not a thesis break. But it is the first name to go if one develops.

One order validated: buy $190 of NEAR at market, roughly 65.81 coins near $2.865, $1.43 fee. Six of seven lenses green — momentum, relative strength, trend, breakout, position confirmation, room to prior highs. The only red is regime, and regime is the reason to size at $190 rather than reach for more. ZEC scored five and was passed over deliberately: it is thirty days into a 2.65x, and a ten-percent green candle at the top of a parabolic is the most expensive chart in crypto. NEAR's move is one day old. That is the difference. The cost is concentration — NEAR becomes a third of the book — and we are taking it knowingly, not accidentally.
